content: Standard WinForms single-instance pattern: named System.Threading.Mutex acquired at startup; second instance failing to acquire it locates the first instance's window (e.g. Process.GetProcessesByName + MainWindowHandle) and calls ShowWindow(SW_RESTORE)+SetForegroundWindow on it before exiting. Works reliably because the newly-launched process still holds foreground-activation rights at that moment; WM_COPYDATA/named-pipe IPC is a more robust alternative for passing an 'activate' signal into the first instance's own message loop.
